name: ios-agentic-toolkit
description: Supervised, evidence-first agentic workflows for iOS engineering: crash investigation and approval-gated fixing, design systems from references to generated SwiftUI, verified feature inventories and flow specs for migrating legacy apps, and build-error-driven code ports with parallel design-system restyling, new SwiftUI screens on the design system behind a token-usage gate, read-only visual review of screenshots against the design system and mobile UX rules, plus VNCBar, a menu bar app for one-click logins to remote Macs.
